description: HydroMap is an R package for interpolating sparse groundwater-head observations into a spatial water-table estimate. Its kriging method can account for terrain, geology and fixed-head boundaries, with parameters fitted by split-sample maximum likelihood. Users supply observation wells, elevation and optional land-type or boundary layers. Outputs are groundwater-head or water-table-depth maps for the selected area and observation period. Geographic coverage depends on the supplied monitoring network; the README illustrates Victoria, Australia. The repository offers a release archive, R installation steps and a basic manual under GPL-3.0 terms. The maintainers call this a beta release and say some functions remain undocumented. A limitation is that interpolation does not model pumping, recharge or aquifer dynamics, and accuracy falls where observation coverage is weak. The tool can make initial groundwater conditions for water-supply or flood simulation. The related catalogue Costa Rica groundwater network is a separate monitoring source. No well data or R package was downloaded.
inputs: Groundwater observations and terrain or geology layers
name: HydroMap groundwater-level interpolation
